rationale: The attached source images support a general component-propagation claim in a complete eigenvector basis. The blind translation consistently describes a valid single-mode construction statement, with matching PDE arithmetic and signed-speed convention, but changes both the applicable matrix class and the role of the unknown field. It neither represents the complete decomposition nor derives propagation of arbitrary solution components. The result is classified as not-faithful-different, with adjudication requested for the unresolved regularity scope.
